# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis is a handsome young lady known for her showy looks. She possesses large, bright-blue eyes, a brilliant complexion, a plump figure, and a long yellow braid of hair that can be worn flowing.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Cheerful and good-tempered, she frankly enjoys the pleasant things in life, though she can be inclined toward sentimentality and hysterics. She is deeply preoccupied with young men, aiming to have a beau by age fifteen, attract many suitors as she grows up, and marry after a brief two years of teaching. Additionally, she harbors a intense dread of caterpillars.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis charmed away all of her warts using a magic pebble given to her by old [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) from the Creek. Knowledgeable about romantic and social matters due to having many older sisters, Ruby participated in local school life alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their peers. She joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their friends in forming a story club and took part in re-enacting a poem on a flat-bottomed boat. Ruby later joined Miss Stacy's advanced preparation class for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination to study to become a teacher, ultimately attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with her classmates.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby is a schoolmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their friendship involves simple gestures like sharing apples at school. Ruby remains part of Anne's social circle, participating in group visits and activities during their time as students under Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), +10 more_
